description: SwiftUI extension for the OnboardingView, defining various onboarding pages and components for the OpenClaw macOS app, including gateway setup, permissions, CLI installation, workspace configuration, and onboarding chat interface.

methods.name: pageView
methods.description: Returns a different onboarding page view depending on the pageIndex parameter, effectively switching views for each onboarding step.

methods.name: welcomePage
methods.description: Creates the welcome page with information about OpenClaw and security notices.

methods.name: connectionPage
methods.description: Builds the connection setup page where the user can choose or configure gateways and connection modes.

methods.name: permissionsPage
methods.description: Displays permissions that the user needs to grant, such as automation and app permissions for macOS.

methods.name: cliPage
methods.description: Guides the user through CLI installation and setup for local mode operation.

methods.name: workspacePage
methods.description: Provides interface for creating or configuring the agent's workspace directory.

methods.name: onboardingChatPage
methods.description: Embeds a dedicated onboarding chat UI for user-agent interaction.

methods.name: readyPage
methods.description: Final onboarding page indicating setup completion with options for further configuration.
